approval.approval_statement: I, Gaurav Thakare, authorize execution of the frozen InsightFlow AI V2.8.2 Official Step 7 experiment bound to the benchmark freeze SHA-256 e8505f10a62d1c7a6dc068f34d9382ab3451bdc3da4777794b52255ebf8f6705, implementation commit 25de205a6d96cdd578d1999474ff41fd68316a77, and V2.8.2 freeze-record SHA-256 b116a3e21c57746dad8321e6bb1b009c8bf781ee8db66abf67dbdf3ef8cafe0a. This authorization covers exactly 100 benchmark cases and the four scheduled error-injection cases under the frozen protocol. It does not authorize changes to the benchmark, ground truth, metrics, conditions, evaluator, or experiment protocol.
